summary: This note covers the first leg of the 2013 Supercopa de España, played on 21 August in Madrid. David Villa, a former Barcelona striker, gave Atlético Madrid the lead after 12 minutes with a right-footed volley. Barcelona equalized in the 66th minute through substitute Neymar, who headed in from a cross by Dani Alves.
one_line: First leg of the 2013 Supercopa de España, where Atlético Madrid and Barcelona drew 1-1 in Madrid on 21 August.
key_facts: The first leg of the 2013 Supercopa de España was played on 21 August in Madrid.
David Villa is described as a former Barcelona striker.
David Villa put Atlético Madrid ahead after 12 minutes.
Villa scored with a right-footed volley into the back of the net after a cross from the left.
Neymar scored Barcelona's equalizer as a substitute.
Neymar headed in at the far post.
The cross for Neymar's goal was a high cross by Dani Alves from the right.
The note describes Atlético Madrid as leading after Villa's goal and Barcelona level after Neymar's goal.
The note covers only the first leg and does not give a final result or the second leg.
